page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E4.Flex.64-1024 is an enterprise virtual machine configuration driven by AMD EPYC 7J13 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server allocates 64 dedicated physical cores supporting 128 vCPUs via simultaneous multithreading with two threads per core. System memory totals 1024.0 GB, establishing a high memory allocation ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or hardware accelerators, leaving the GPU count at zero. Persistent file systems and database persistence depend entirely on network-attached block storage volumes. Network connectivity provides one complimentary public IPv4 address.

With an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance delivers memory density suited for data-heavy tasks without bare-metal infrastructure overhead. The lack of onboard NVMe storage represents a tradeoff requiring external block storage throughput. Primary workload fits include large in-memory databases, memory-heavy batch processing, enterprise resource planning platforms, and distributed data analytics.
